title: Vishnu (Dashavathara on Prabhavli)
brief_description: Image of Vishnu prabhavali carved with Dasavathara. Prabhavali broken but horse piece available. Front hands broken.
detailed_description: Richly emblished slenderly carved image of Vishnu with details of Dashavtara. The four handed deity wears heavy ornamentation - kirita mukutha (crown) necklaces, armlets, ear-rings, katibandha (waist band), ornamental yajnopavita (scared thread) and anklets; the lower portion of the image is covered with the characteristic costume of vaishnative images with elaborate liner drapery falling from waist-line till the feet on either side. Three hands below the elbow are broken and attributes are lost. Vishnu is flank-ed by two adoring female figures and the prabhavali around his head represents his Dashavtara Matsya, kurma, Varaha, Vamana, Narasinvha, Rama, Parshurama, Krishna, Buddha, Kalki etc.
